text:
alex_w: Heads-up — after the kernel selector change yesterday I'm seeing prefill hit-rate drop ~12% for baseline web prompts. Deploy warmers ran but numbers don't match previous runs. Anyone else?
maya_s: saw that in the perf dashboard this morning. latency stable but token cost went up due to fewer cache hits. :eyes:
carlos_r: interesting — was the kernel switch to the new fused-attn path? that can change KV layout/eviction timing.
alex_w: yep, fused-attn + new kernel-indexing. runtime logs show prefill jobs completed but the warmers' key cardinality is higher than expected.
jen_l: autoscaler triggered a scale-down during the post-deploy warmers window on one cluster. could be racing with eviction.
perfbot: smokecheck report:
```
prefill_hit_rate: 0.72 -> 0.60 (-12%)
avg_latency_ms: 48 -> 50 (+2ms)
median_tokens_saved: 480 -> 410 (-14%)
warmers_jobs_ok: 12/12
autoscale_events: 2 during warmup
```
maya_s: attaching quick profile snapshot (abbrev):
```
KV_mem_hits: 58%
KV_lookup_lat: 0.9ms
batch_window_ms: 8
KV_eviction_stdev: 24%
```
carlos_r: hypothesis: new kernel changes index encoding, so our canonical cache key normalization (we hash prefix+tgt_len) no longer maps as collision-free -> higher cardinality and lower effective reuse. also scale-down evicts active shards mid-warm.
alex_w: ok, pragmatic mitigation ideas: 1) phase warmers into two waves: immediate per-deploy light probe + delayed heavy prefill after 90s 2) pin nodes for 2m after deploy to avoid eviction racing 3) run synthetic targeted warmers that mirror high-card prefixes we saw before the kernel swap
jen_l: +1 to pinned grace period. autoscaler policy tweak is trivial (extend no-scale window), ops can roll that.
maya_s: I can produce a small script to synthesize the old key distribution. sample command: `python tools/synth_warmer.py --seed-distribution historical_keys.json --concurrency 16 --duration 60`
carlos_r: also propose KV key normalization patch: canonicalize attention-block metadata out of the serialized key before hashing. shouldn't affect correctness, just key stability across kernel variants. i'll draft PR.
perfbot: alert: warmup job timings show 30% of warmers finish after autoscale events.
alex_w: short-term runbook:
- ops: set cluster deploy-grace to 120s for next 48h (@jen_l)
- eng-runtime: roll synthetic warmers matching old prefix histogram, run one night job (@maya_s)
- infra: test canonicalization patch in staging kernel build, measure hit-rate before canary (p0) (@carlos_r)
- monitor: add a warmers vs autoscale overlay to perf dashboard (p1) (@alex_w)
jen_l: I'll apply deploy-grace and notify infra.
maya_s: starting the synth run at 0200UTC, will post summary.
carlos_r: PR up for key-normalization, unit tests included. not touching on-disk layout, just the hash input. request review.
alex_w: thanks — goal is to get hit-rate back within 3% of baseline before next kernel rollout. can we also add a quick smoke job that runs after autoscale events to re-seed hotkeys?
jen_l: we can add an event-hook: on-scale (down) -> trigger rewarm job with low qps for 30s. trivial to wire.
maya_s: noting one caveat: some customers have very high prefix entropy; our synth warmers should be conservative there to avoid cost spikes. will parameterize by tenant.
perfbot: Next scheduled check in 6h; will post aggregated metrics. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
alex_w: perfect. will follow up with dashboard mock and assign owners. cheers. :thumbsup:
